trainingGames.storyline: You helm an agent studio tasked with aligning planner, researcher, and writer roles so briefs land with precision.

levels.title: Level 1 — Intent Lab
levels.summary: Frame the arena: personas, privacy, and success checkpoints.
levels.objective: Complete the intent canvas and compliance guardrails.
npcHints: Match each persona to a privacy lane before launching.
Log fallback channels so humans can intervene fast.

resources.title: Guardrail Guide
resources.sub: Examples of tone and privacy rules.

challenge.prompt: Reorder the intent-canvas ritual before agents go live.

levels.title: Level 2 — Graph Forge
levels.summary: Design the planner → researcher → synthesizer relay.
levels.objective: Lay out agent roles with checkpoints and memory slots.
npcHints: Keep the researcher brief short and scoped.
Insert an eval stop before the final answer ships.

challenge.scenario: Your planner wants to skip a stage to move faster.
challenge.question: What keeps the graph healthy?

options.label: Skip evaluator for speed
options.feedback: Tone will drift without a guardrail.

options.label: Let researcher send straight to the user

levels.title: Level 3 — Eval Sprint
levels.summary: Teach agents to score themselves against the rubric.
levels.objective: Wire automated scoring with human fallback switching.
npcHints: Blend tone and factual weights to match the brand.
Keep escalation visible so owners can override instantly.

trainingGames.storyline: You coordinate a neighborhood DAO where utility, governance, and treasury health need to stay in sync.
trainingGames.bossChallenge: Launch a governance proposal with clear utility and alert automations.

rewards.label: Governance Ops Pack
rewards.description: Proposal templates and community automation flows.

levels.title: Level 1 — Utility Forge
levels.summary: Define how members earn, spend, and influence with the token.
levels.objective: Map roles, unlockables, and contribution rewards.
npcHints: Give builders extra voting weight for depth contributions.
Limit perks to what the core team can maintain reliably.

challenge.scenario: Community wants real utility before buying the token.
challenge.question: Which move wins trust?

options.label: Gate voting + workrooms with the token

levels.title: Level 2 — Treasury Run
levels.summary: Run a voting simulation plus payout automation.
levels.objective: Draft the proposal lifecycle with alerts and audits.
npcHints: Trigger Discord alerts when quorum is close.
Add an audit trail for multi-sig actions.

challenge.prompt: Reorder the lightweight snapshot vote loop.

levels.title: Level 3 — Community Pulse
levels.summary: Blend engagement metrics with health alerts.
levels.objective: Deploy reputation rules and feedback loops.
npcHints: Reward collaboration, not just voting frequency.
Segment alerts by roles to avoid notification fatigue.

challenge.question: How do you keep veteran contributors rewarded?

levels.title: Level 1 — Hypothesis Deck

levels.title: Level 2 — Lab Orchestration

levels.title: Level 3 — Publish Sprint
